comments.body: You could try looking at labs and see if anything piques your interest. Then contact the professor or other members of the scientific staff to ask if there are any oppurtunities, they can be surprisingly helpful. Contrary to the other comments, I can confirm that this is possible, because I actually supervised a high school student from Hamburg for a bit while I was working as a research assistant. It was great fun for him and I can highly recommend it.
comments.author: LG193
